summary: Global render/audio system initializer. Zeroes the entry-array region from byte_8B5A3C to byte_8B6ABC in 132-byte strides, resets a batch of global flags (counts, handles, thresholds), then branches on the a5 init-flag bits: bit 1 skips audio configuration, bit 2 applies the '2' quality preset (audio-quality=2, 0.5/0.5 scale factors) and bit 3 the '3' preset (0.33340001/0.33340001) before starting the audio subsystem (sub_53D750) and calling sub_55BE80(a4, a5&1). Then runs ArithmeticComparison_b0d0, initializes audio channels, allocates and zero-initializes a 160-byte network-config object into dword_8B8F04, runs sub_55F0D0 and GlobalMemoryStatusWrapper, and allocates a 12-byte object into dword_8B8F2C. Always returns 0. Called by SystemInitAllocatorWrapper.
